text: Seawater used for once-through cooling shall be assumed to have chloride concentration up to the maximum of DP-OWNR-0014, temperature range per DP-OWNR-0011 to DP-OWNR-0013, suspended solids up to the storm value of DP-OWNR-0017 and a jellyfish load per DP-OWNR-0019. Salinity is low (brackish, DP-OWNR-0015); the design shall however assume full-strength chloride corrosivity for pitting and crevice corrosion, since salinity varies with the pycnocline layer.
